issue.title: Build Settings Page with Gear Icon Entry Point
issue.body: Several features across Fluent Mobile require a persistent settings surface — cellular sync opt-in, proactive offline preparation, and logout. Without a defined entry point, these settings have no home and dependent tickets cannot be finalized. A gear icon in the top-left of the home screen header provides a discoverable entry point; a full-screen Settings page sits behind it. Sub-page headers are unaffected. ## Functional Requirements ### Gear Icon Entry Point - Add a settings icon (`li:settings`) to the top left of the home screen header. - Tapping it navigates to the Settings page. - The icon appears only on the home screen header — sub-page headers are unaffected. ### Page Header - Display "Settings" as the page title. - Include a back button (`li:chevron-left`) in the top left. ### Offline Preparation - Display a "Prepare for Offline" row with a right-facing arrow (`li:chevron-right`) that navigates to the Prepare for Offline page (#39). ### Sync - Display an "Upload over cellular" toggle, off by default. - When off, the app uploads only over WiFi; when on, the app uploads over cellular without an additional prompt. ### Account - Display a "Log out" option that signs the user out and returns them to the login page. - If unsynced work exists on the device, prompt the user to confirm before logging out.

comments.body: Approved and merged. Also we will iterate over this screen and functionality in the near future.
